# Tonguç Karaçay — Extended Public Website Index

This is a machine-readable directory of selected public resources from tonguckaracay.com, maintained alongside the site's original `/llms.txt`. It is not a complete copy of the website, and inclusion does not imply search-engine or AI citation priority.

## Author and website

Tonguç Karaçay is an Istanbul-based UI/UX design, SEO, GEO, digital marketing and AI automation consultant.
